sources_note: 來源涵蓋 TechCrunch、AdWeek、Digiday、Campaign Asia、The Drum、Marketing Interactive、量子位、可靈 AI 及各平台官方發布。
sources_note_en: Sources include TechCrunch, AdWeek, Digiday, Campaign Asia, The Drum, Marketing Interactive, QbitAI, Kling AI Blog, and official platform announcements.
thesis: AI 正從兩端夾擊品牌觸達機會：搜尋端被 AI 引擎壓縮自然流量，購買端被 AI 代理直接代替消費者完成交易。
thesis_en: AI is squeezing brand reach from both ends: AI answer engines compressing organic search traffic, and AI agents completing purchases autonomously on behalf of consumers.
thesis_note: 今日三條主線——Meta Muse 代理購物、Instacart AI 購物車、出版商付費搜尋激增——同時指向同一個結構性轉變：消費者旅程的入口（搜尋發現）與終點（購買執行）都正在被 AI 接管。行銷人需同時部署 AEO 內容策略，以及在 AI 代理推薦層面建立品牌存在感。
thesis_note_en: Three dominant stories today — Meta Muse's agentic shopping, Instacart's AI cart builder, and publishers' paid search surge — all point to the same structural shift: AI is taking over both the discovery entry point (search) and the purchase exit point (checkout) of the consumer journey. Marketers must simultaneously deploy AEO content strategies and establish brand presence within AI agent recommendation layers.

items.title: Meta 推出個人 AI 代理 Muse，可代使用者完成購物與付款
items.title_en: Meta Launches Personal AI Agent Muse, Capable of Autonomous Shopping and Payments
items.summary: Meta Muse 整合旅遊預訂、代理談判與支付（Stripe／Shop Pay），應用關閉後仍可持續執行，訂閱月費最高 100 美元，為首個面向普通消費者的個人 AI 代理。
items.summary_en: Meta Muse integrates travel booking, negotiation, and payments (Stripe/Shop Pay), continues running when the app is closed, and offers up to $100/month subscriptions — the first personal AI agent for mainstream consumers.
items.why: AI 代理繞過廣告直接完成購買，品牌需重新評估消費者決策的介入點與觸達策略。
items.why_en: AI agents bypass ads to complete purchases directly, forcing brands to rethink intervention points and touchpoint strategy.
highlights: Muse 可在使用者關閉應用後繼續自動執行任務，並僅在需要批准時返回通知，標誌 AI 代理進入「持續運行」新階段。
整合 Stripe Link 及 Shop Pay 付款能力，AI 代理可直接代替消費者完成交易，而無需進入廣告主頁面。
Meta 明確聲明 Muse 的對話與虛擬機器數據不會流入廣告系統，使用者亦可選擇退出模型訓練。
highlights_en: Muse continues executing tasks after users close the app, returning only for approval — marking AI agents entering a 'persistent execution' era.
With Stripe Link and Shop Pay integration, Muse can complete transactions on users' behalf without visiting advertiser landing pages.
Meta explicitly states Muse conversation and VM data will not feed into its ad systems, with an opt-out for model training.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.pattern: AI 代理接管購買決策的趨勢正在加速：同期 Instacart、Shipt、Uber Eats 亦推出 AI 購物車助理，AI 代理已逐步成為電商生態的標配入口。品牌應即時審視在 AI 推薦層面的存在感，而非僅依賴傳統廣告觸達。
items.pattern_en: The AI-agent shopping takeover is accelerating: Instacart, Shipt, and Uber Eats simultaneously launched AI cart builders. Brands should audit their presence in AI recommendation layers rather than relying solely on traditional ad touchpoints.

items.title: Suno 推出 v6：首個以授權音樂訓練的 AI 音樂模型
items.title_en: Suno Launches v6: First AI Music Model Trained Entirely on Licensed Music
items.summary: Suno v6 完全以 Warner、BMG 等授權音樂訓練，支援文字、圖像及影片多模態輸入，v6-mini 版本免費開放，大幅降低廣告配樂的版權風險。
items.summary_en: Suno v6 is trained exclusively on licensed music from Warner and BMG, supports multimodal inputs (text, image, video), and offers a free v6-mini tier — significantly reducing copyright risk for commercial audio production.
items.why: 授權訓練的音樂 AI 令廣告配樂更安全合規，品牌可以更大膽整合 AI 音樂入素材工作流。
items.why_en: Licensed-training AI music makes ad audio production safer and more compliant, enabling brands to integrate AI music more boldly into creative workflows.
highlights: Suno v6 全面採用 Warner、BMG 等主要唱片公司授權音樂訓練，解決業界最關注的版權合規問題。
模型支援以文字、圖像、影片作為創作參考，並可進行逐段編輯與樂器分離，適用於廣告音樂客製化。
v6-mini 免費開放所有使用者，v6 及 v6-wild 則限付費訂閱，三個版本滿足不同製作需求。
highlights_en: Suno v6 is fully trained on music licensed from major labels including Warner and BMG, directly addressing the industry's top copyright compliance concern.
The model accepts text, image, and video references, with per-segment editing and instrument isolation for ad music customization.
v6-mini is free for all users; v6 and v6-wild are paid-tier exclusives, covering production needs across three tiers.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Mistral 完成 30 億歐元 D 輪，歐洲主權 AI 估值達 210 億歐元
items.title_en: Mistral Raises €3B Series D at €21B Valuation, Cementing European Sovereign AI
items.summary: Mistral 完成歐洲科技史上最大規模股權融資，由三星領投，客戶可自選數據處理地區，以主權 AI 定位進軍政府及企業市場，a16z、Nvidia 與列投資方。
items.summary_en: Mistral closed Europe's largest-ever tech equity round led by Samsung, with data residency choice as a core differentiator targeting governments and enterprises. Backers include a16z and Nvidia.
items.why: 主權 AI 崛起，廣告主與 Agency 在選擇 AI 供應商時需考量數據主權及法規合規風險。
items.why_en: Sovereign AI's rise signals that brands and agencies must weigh data residency and compliance risk when selecting AI vendor partnerships.
highlights: Mistral 目前於 20 個國家營運，強調不依賴美國或中國 AI 基礎設施，主攻主權意識強的政府與企業客戶。
投資方包括三星（領投）、a16z、Nvidia 及 Salesforce Ventures，反映主流科技資本對歐洲 AI 的持續信心。
客戶可自選數據處理地區的設計，直接回應全球品牌對數據跨境傳輸合規的日益嚴格要求。
highlights_en: Mistral operates in 20 countries, deliberately avoiding U.S. and Chinese AI infrastructure to serve sovereignty-conscious government and enterprise clients.
Backers include Samsung (lead), a16z, Nvidia, and Salesforce Ventures, reflecting sustained mainstream tech capital confidence in European AI.
Client-selectable data residency directly addresses brands' increasingly strict requirements around cross-border data transfer compliance.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Cloud 與 Accenture 聯手成立 Gemini 企業部門，派駐逾千名工程師加速落地
items.title_en: Google Cloud and Accenture Form Dedicated Gemini Enterprise Group with 1,000+ Deployed Engineers
items.summary: Google Cloud 與 Accenture 成立 Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group，Google 直接培訓並派駐逾千名工程師入駐企業客戶，惟其企業 AI 市佔率目前僅 6%。
items.summary_en: Google Cloud and Accenture formed the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group, with 1,000+ Google-trained engineers forward-deployed to enterprise clients — despite Google holding just 6% of enterprise AI spend.
items.why: Google 大力補貼企業 AI 落地，廣告主應重新評估 Gemini 行銷工具的採用時機與路線圖。
items.why_en: Google's aggressive enterprise AI subsidy signals advertisers should reassess the adoption timeline and roadmap for Gemini marketing tools.
highlights: 市場研究顯示企業 AI 支出中 Anthropic 佔 43.5%、OpenAI 佔 39.7%，Google 僅佔 6%，差距催生此次戰略佈局。
Google 另承諾建立 7.5 億美元合作夥伴生態，涵蓋 Capgemini、Cognizant 及 Deloitte，加速企業部署規模。
Accenture 旗下 Gemini 工程師將直接進駐客戶團隊協助落地，標誌 Google 由雲端服務轉向主動式服務模式。
highlights_en: Enterprise AI spend data shows Anthropic at 43.5% and OpenAI at 39.7%, versus Google's 6% — a gap that directly motivated this strategic move.
Google also committed to a $750M partner ecosystem spanning Capgemini, Cognizant, and Deloitte to scale enterprise deployment.
Accenture's Gemini engineers will be forward-deployed inside client teams, marking Google's shift from cloud services to proactive embedded delivery.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 蘋果發布首款折疊機 iPhone Duo，Siri 整合逾 30 萬個 App，中文 AI 版繼續延遲
items.title_en: Apple Launches Foldable iPhone Duo, Siri Integrates 300K+ Apps — Chinese AI Version Further Delayed
items.summary: 蘋果推出首款折疊機 iPhone Duo（¥15,999 起）及 iPhone 18 Pro，Siri 現整合逾 30 萬個 App 可跨 App 執行任務，Apple Intelligence 中文版繼續延遲。
items.summary_en: Apple launched the foldable iPhone Duo (from ¥15,999) and iPhone 18 Pro. Siri now integrates 300,000+ apps for cross-app task execution, while Apple Intelligence's Chinese version faces further delays.
items.why: 折疊機改變廣告版位設計邏輯，AI Siri 跨 App 能力影響品牌 App 與助理生態整合策略。
items.why_en: The foldable form factor reshapes ad placement design logic; AI Siri's cross-app capability reshapes brand app and assistant ecosystem integration strategy.
highlights: Siri 現整合逾 30 萬個 App，可跨 App 代使用者執行複合任務，為品牌 App 與 AI 助理生態整合帶來新機遇。
Safari 新增網頁自動監測功能，可在指定內容變更時發出提示，對廣告主進行競爭對手追蹤有實際應用價值。
Apple Intelligence 中文版進一步延遲，香港及中國大陸市場短期內仍無法使用相關 AI 功能，需另作部署規劃。
highlights_en: Siri now integrates with 300,000+ apps for cross-app task execution, opening new opportunities for brand apps to be part of the AI assistant ecosystem.
Safari gains automated webpage monitoring with change alerts, offering practical competitive intelligence applications for advertisers.
Apple Intelligence Chinese-language support faces further delays, leaving Hong Kong and mainland markets without access to these AI features short-term.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 出版商每月花逾億美元買搜尋流量，AI 搜尋衝擊三年推動支出增 274%
items.title_en: Publishers Spend $113M/Month on Paid Search as AI Search Drives 274% Three-Year Surge
items.summary: Similarweb 數據顯示，2026 年 7 月頂級媒體付費搜尋月支出達 1.13 億美元，Forbes 單月近 7,220 萬元，AI 搜尋零點擊衝擊令三年累積增幅達 274%。
items.summary_en: Similarweb data shows top publishers spent $113M on paid search in July 2026 — Forbes alone nearly $72.2M — as AI search zero-click impacts drive a 274% three-year cumulative surge.
items.why: AI 搜尋正侵蝕自然流量，AEO 已成品牌維持搜尋能見度的必要投資方向。
items.why_en: AI search is eroding organic traffic, making Answer Engine Optimization a necessary investment for brands to maintain search visibility.
highlights: Similarweb 頂級媒體指數顯示，2026 年 7 月付費搜尋總支出達 1.13 億美元，按年增長 41%，三年累積升幅達 274%。
CNN 及 USA Today 自然搜尋流量分別下跌近 29% 及 24%，出版商以付費搜尋自救正形成可觀的財務壓力。
分析師警告，大幅增加付費搜尋投入實際上是補貼 Google 的廣告收入，形成出版商自我削弱的惡性循環。
highlights_en: Similarweb's top media index shows $113M in paid search spend in July 2026, up 41% year-over-year and 274% over three years.
CNN and USA Today saw organic search traffic fall roughly 29% and 24% respectively, as publishers' paid search self-rescue creates significant financial strain.
Analysts warn that heavy paid search investment is effectively subsidizing Google's ad revenue, creating a self-defeating cycle that weakens publishers further.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.pattern: 此趨勢直接呼應 Autodesk CMO 所提的 AEO 框架：品牌應主動將內容結構化以獲得 AI 搜尋的自然引用，而非持續加大付費搜尋投入來彌補 AI 帶來的流量流失。
items.pattern_en: This trend directly echoes the AEO framework raised by Autodesk's CMO: brands should proactively structure content to earn organic AI search citations, rather than continuously increasing paid search spend to offset AI-driven traffic losses.

items.title: Autodesk CMO：AI 時代行銷需雙軌並行，AEO 已是必要能力
items.title_en: Autodesk CMO: AI-Era Marketing Demands Dual-Track Strategy — AEO Is Now a Core Competency
items.summary: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder 提出雙軌框架：AI 代理需結構化事實數據，人類買家需情感共鳴，她親自測試 AI 搜尋查詢以核查品牌能見度，視 AEO 為必要行銷能力。
items.summary_en: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder proposes a dual-track framework: AI agents need structured factual data, human buyers need emotional resonance. She personally tests AI search queries to verify brand visibility, treating AEO as a core marketing competency.
items.why: AEO 正式取代 SEO 成為 B2B 行銷新優先項，即時調整內容結構可維持 AI 搜尋能見度。
items.why_en: AEO is overtaking SEO as the new B2B marketing priority — restructuring content now can maintain visibility as AI search grows dominant.
highlights: Treseder 指出品牌需同時服務兩類受眾：需要準確結構化數據的 AI 代理，以及需要情感故事的人類買家，兩者缺一不可。
她親自測試 AI 搜尋查詢以驗證品牌能見度，認為 AEO（答案引擎優化）是行銷團隊不可委外的核心能力。
Autodesk 新品牌廣告以人類為主角而非科技，同步推進 NFL 賽季曝光與 LA28 奧運合作夥伴關是。
highlights_en: Treseder argues brands must serve two audiences simultaneously: AI agents requiring accurate structured data, and human buyers who respond to emotional storytelling.
She personally tests AI search queries to verify brand visibility, treating AEO as a core competency that marketing teams cannot outsource.
Autodesk's new brand campaign centers humans rather than technology, running through the NFL season alongside its LA28 Olympics partnership.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: PubMatic 進駐香港，主攻中國品牌出海廣告預算
items.title_en: PubMatic Opens Hong Kong Office Targeting Chinese Outbound Ad Spend
items.summary: 程序化廣告平台 PubMatic 宣布開設香港辦公室，繼澳洲墨爾本後持續擴展亞太版圖，目標協助中國品牌有效部署出海廣告預算至海外受眾。
items.summary_en: Programmatic ad platform PubMatic announced a Hong Kong office following its recent Melbourne launch, targeting Chinese brands looking to deploy outbound advertising budgets to international audiences.
items.why: 中國品牌出海廣告需求持續增長，香港 Agency 可藉此承接跨境業務，擴展服務收入來源。
items.why_en: Growing Chinese outbound ad demand creates opportunities for Hong Kong agencies to capture cross-border business and expand service revenue.
highlights: PubMatic 選擇香港作為連接中國廣告主與國際受眾的戰略樞紐，瞄準中國品牌全球化的結構性增長趨勢。
此次擴張緊隨墨爾本新辦公室開幕，反映 PubMatic 加速亞太地區佈局的整體戰略方向。
亞太廣告解決方案副總裁 Sudipto Das 闡述，香港在協助中國品牌觸達東南亞及西方市場方面具有獨特定位。
highlights_en: PubMatic chose Hong Kong as a strategic gateway connecting Chinese advertisers to international audiences, targeting the structural growth trend of Chinese brand globalization.
The Hong Kong launch follows a recent Melbourne office opening, reflecting PubMatic's accelerating Asia-Pacific expansion strategy.
APAC Advertising Solutions VP Sudipto Das highlighted Hong Kong's unique positioning in helping Chinese brands reach Southeast Asian and Western markets.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 可靈 AI 發布 2026 年 10 大 AI 圖像工具橫向評測，IMAGE 3.0 支援 10 張參考圖奪優
items.title_en: Kling AI Reviews Top 10 AI Image Tools of 2026 — IMAGE 3.0's 10-Reference Support Takes the Lead
items.summary: 可靈 AI 橫向比較 Midjourney、Adobe Firefly、Ideogram 等 10 款主流工具，IMAGE 3.0 以最多 10 張參考圖、自然語言局部編輯及 4K 輸出為主要差異化優勢。
items.summary_en: Kling AI benchmarks 10 leading AI image tools including Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, and Ideogram, with IMAGE 3.0 differentiating through up to 10 reference images, natural-language editing, and 4K output.
items.why: 工具選型指引協助廣告創作團隊為不同素材需求選擇最合適的 AI 圖像工具，提升製作效率。
items.why_en: Tool selection guidance helps creative ad teams choose the best AI image tool for different asset requirements, improving production efficiency.
highlights: IMAGE 3.0 Omni 的 Image Series Mode 可從同一視覺方向生成一系列相關圖像，適合需要視覺一致性的品牌 Campaign。
最多 10 張參考圖同時輸入，直接解決廣告素材製作中角色及品牌視覺一致性的核心痛點。
原生 2K／4K 輸出規格符合戶外廣告及高清數位媒體的投放標準，減少後期放大損耗。
highlights_en: IMAGE 3.0 Omni's Image Series Mode generates related image sets from one visual direction, ideal for brand campaigns requiring visual consistency.
Up to 10 simultaneous reference images directly address character and brand visual consistency — the core pain point in ad creative production.
Native 2K/4K output meets OOH advertising and high-resolution digital media specs, eliminating quality loss from post-production upscaling.

items.title: 實測星火 X2.5：一句提示生成遊戲官網、拆解 61 頁財報、偵測問卷造假
items.title_en: Hands-On with Spark X2.5: One Prompt Builds a Game Site, Parses 61-Page Earnings, Detects Survey Fraud
items.summary: 量子位實測科大訊飛星火 X2.5（293B MoE 參數），可以單一提示生成互動式品牌官網、解析長財報並輸出圖表，API 相容 Anthropic 協議，可整合至現有開發工具鏈。
items.summary_en: QbitAI tested iFlytek's Spark X2.5 (293B MoE), capable of generating interactive brand websites from a single prompt, parsing 61-page earnings reports with chart output, and detecting survey fabrication. API is compatible with Anthropic protocols.
items.why: 國產大模型兼備創意生成與數據分析能力，可納入廣告公司工作流作本地化替代方案評估。
items.why_en: A domestic LLM with both creative generation and data analysis capabilities, worth evaluating as a localization-friendly alternative in agency workflows.
highlights: Spark X2.5 以單一世界觀提示生成包含哥德式美術、關卡地圖及導覽功能的完整遊戲宣傳網站，適合快速原型製作。
解析 61 頁 NVIDIA 財報後輸出 9 張圖表及投資風險摘要，數字準確性已由人工核實，適用於廣告主數據驅動簡報。
API 相容 Anthropic 及 Responses 協議，可整合至 Claude Code、Codex 等現有開發工具鏈，降低切換成本。
highlights_en: Spark X2.5 generates a full game promotional website with Gothic art, level maps, and navigation from a single world-building prompt, enabling rapid creative prototyping.
It parsed a 61-page NVIDIA earnings report and produced 9 charts plus an investment risk brief with human-verified numerical accuracy, suitable for data-driven client presentations.
API compatibility with Anthropic and Responses protocols allows integration into existing toolchains like Claude Code and Codex, reducing switching costs.

items.title: Andrew Robertson 接掌 Omnicom Advertising，Troy Ruhanen 退休
items.title_en: Andrew Robertson Named CEO of Omnicom Advertising as Troy Ruhanen Retires
items.summary: BBDO 主席 Andrew Robertson 出任新成立的 Omnicom Advertising 行政總裁，接替退休的 Troy Ruhanen，此次交接發生於 Omnicom 完成收購 IPG 並重組架構後。
items.summary_en: BBDO chairman Andrew Robertson was named CEO of the newly formed Omnicom Advertising, replacing the retiring Troy Ruhanen. The transition follows Omnicom's acquisition of IPG and subsequent restructuring.
items.why: 全球最大廣告集團領導層更替，影響旗下品牌服務方向與 Agency 競爭格局，客戶新約洽談值得關注。
items.why_en: Leadership change at a top global holding company will shape subsidiary agency strategies and competitive dynamics — worth monitoring for client contract implications.
highlights: Robertson 在 BBDO 服務逾 30 年，以即時生效方式出任 Omnicom Advertising 行政總裁，並保留 BBDO 現有架構。
Troy Ruhanen 的退休計劃因 Omnicom 收購 IPG 而延後，待整合架構穩定後方才落實，標誌後 IPG 時代整合進入新階段。
Omnicom Advertising 是 Omnicom 收購 IPG 後新設的統一廣告業務實體，整合原有多個創意 Agency 品牌。
highlights_en: Robertson, with over 30 years at BBDO, takes the CEO role at Omnicom Advertising effective immediately, retaining BBDO's existing structure.
Ruhanen's retirement was delayed pending completion of the IPG acquisition integration, marking the beginning of a new phase in the post-IPG era.
Omnicom Advertising is a newly formed entity created to consolidate multiple creative agency brands following the IPG acquisition.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Instacart 推出 AI 購物助理 Clementine，可將對話與圖片轉化為購物車
items.title_en: Instacart Launches AI Shopping Assistant Clementine, Converting Conversations and Photos into Ready-to-Buy Carts
items.summary: Instacart 推出 Clementine AI 助理，可將自然語言、食譜及上傳圖片轉為購物車，支援飲食偏好篩選與預算建議，Uber Eats、DoorDash、Shipt 同步推出類似工具。
items.summary_en: Instacart launched Clementine, converting conversations, recipes, and uploaded photos into ready-to-buy carts with dietary filtering and budget suggestions. Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Shipt simultaneously launched similar AI tools.
items.why: AI 購物助理重塑消費者預購決策入口，品牌須思考如何在 AI 推薦層面維持產品曝光。
items.why_en: AI shopping assistants are reshaping the pre-purchase decision moment, requiring brands to rethink how they maintain product visibility within AI recommendation layers.
highlights: Clementine 可根據上傳圖片自動識別菜式並生成食材清單，同時整合促銷資訊與平替建議，降低消費者決策摩擦。
Uber Eats、DoorDash 及 Shipt 同步推出類似 AI 購物功能，AI 購物助理已成零售外賣平台的標配競爭項目。
此類工具標誌品牌產品能否進入 AI 推薦清單，將直接影響線上零售曝光率，品牌應主動優化結構化數據。
highlights_en: Clementine auto-identifies dishes from uploaded photos and generates ingredient lists, integrating promotions and lower-cost substitutions to reduce consumer decision friction.
Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Shipt simultaneously launched similar AI shopping features, making AI cart-building a competitive table-stakes requirement for delivery platforms.
Whether a brand's products appear in AI recommendation lists will directly impact online retail visibility, requiring brands to proactively optimize structured product data.

items.title: Trust Bank 推出 AI 對話式交易查詢，金融服務以 AI 重塑客戶自助體驗
items.title_en: Trust Bank Launches AI Conversational Transaction Query — Financial Services Redefining Self-Service with AI
items.summary: Trust Bank 推出「Trust AI Ask」，讓客戶以自然語言查詢消費記錄，宣稱為新加坡零售銀行業首創，現有 GenAI 客服聊天機器人已處理逾 50% 查詢。
items.summary_en: Trust Bank launched 'Trust AI Ask,' enabling natural language transaction queries — claimed as a Singapore retail banking first. Its existing GenAI chatbot already handles 50%+ of customer enquiries end-to-end.
items.why: 對話式 AI 正成為金融服務新標準，對 Fintech 及銀行廣告主有重要參考價值。
items.why_en: Conversational AI is becoming the new standard in financial services — a key reference point for fintech and banking advertisers.
highlights: 約 80% 的 Trust Bank 活躍使用者每月查閱消費記錄，強勁的行為需求直接驅動此 AI 功能的開發決策。
「Trust AI Ask」僅使用使用者自身的交易數據，並設有過濾敏感資訊的私隱保障機制，以解除客戶顧慮。
Trust Bank 計劃由對話式查詢演進至個人化財務洞察，展示 AI 在金融服務中的深度應用路線圖。
highlights_en: Around 80% of Trust Bank's active customers review spending monthly — strong behavioral demand directly informed the decision to build this AI feature.
'Trust AI Ask' uses only the individual customer's own transaction data, with privacy safeguards filtering sensitive information to address customer concerns.
Trust Bank plans to evolve from conversational retrieval to personalized financial insights, showcasing a clear AI deepening roadmap for financial services.

items.title: 可靈 AI 教學：用 IMAGE 3.0 與 VIDEO 3.0 Omni 將真人面孔替換至 AI 角色
items.title_en: Kling AI Tutorial: Replace Real Faces into AI Characters Using IMAGE 3.0 and VIDEO 3.0 Omni
items.summary: 可靈 AI 官方發布完整教學，示範三種工作流：靜態圖像換臉、動態影片換臉，以及以真人照片建立全新 AI 角色，可配合 Lip Sync 製作開口說話的虛擬代言人。
items.summary_en: Kling AI published an official tutorial covering three face-swap workflows: static image face replacement, video face swap, and building new AI characters from a real portrait — with Lip Sync for talking spokesperson output.
items.why: 品牌可即學以真人形象快速建立虛擬代言人，直接應用於影片廣告素材，降低拍攝成本。
items.why_en: Brands can immediately create virtual spokespeople from real portraits for video ad production, cutting on-set shooting costs.
highlights: 使用 IMAGE 3.0 上傳角色圖及人像照片，透過提示詞指令即可替換面孔，同時保留原有風格與構圖。
VIDEO 3.0 Omni 支援 3 至 10 秒角色片段配合多角度人像參考，可在動態與角度變化中完成換臉，維持身份一致性。
完成角色生成後可配合 Native Audio 或 Lip Sync 工具添加對白，呈現可即用的品牌代言人影片效果。
highlights_en: Using IMAGE 3.0, upload a character image and portrait photo, then prompt the model to replace the face while preserving original style and composition.
VIDEO 3.0 Omni supports 3–10 second character clips with multi-angle portrait references, completing face swaps through motion and angle changes while maintaining identity consistency.
After character generation, pair with Native Audio or Lip Sync tools to add dialogue and produce ready-to-use brand spokesperson video output.

items.title: 可靈 AI 完整 Avatar 製作指南：表演提示詞、語音配音與角色重用設定
items.title_en: Kling AI Complete Avatar Creation Guide: Performance Prompting, Voice Dubbing, and Reusable Character Setup
items.summary: 可靈 AI 發布 AI Avatar 完整教學，涵蓋角色外觀生成（最多 10 張參考圖）、表演提示詞撰寫（表情、手勢、肢體動作）、文字轉語音，以及「Generate My Avatar」重用設定。
items.summary_en: Kling AI released a comprehensive AI Avatar guide covering appearance generation (up to 10 reference images), performance prompting (expressions, gestures, body movement), text-to-speech, and the 'Generate My Avatar' feature for reusable character configs.
items.why: 廣告團隊可一次建立有聲虛擬代言人設定，多次重用於不同素材，顯著壓縮影片廣告製作週期。
items.why_en: Ad teams can build voiced virtual brand characters once and reuse them across campaigns, significantly shortening video ad production cycles.
highlights: 表演提示詞可精細控制 Avatar 的表情、手勢、肢體動作及物件互動，無須錄製真人動作即可呈現自然表演效果。
文字轉語音功能支援調整語速與情緒，亦可上傳自錄聲音作配音，令品牌代言人聲音更具一致性。
「Generate My Avatar」可儲存角色設定供日後重複調用，確保跨素材的視覺與聲音一致性，降低每次製作成本。
highlights_en: Performance prompts control Avatar expressions, gestures, body movement, and object interaction without capturing real human motion, delivering natural performance output.
Text-to-speech supports pace and emotion adjustments, and custom voiceover audio can be uploaded to give brand characters a consistent voice identity.
'Generate My Avatar' saves character configurations for reuse across campaigns, ensuring cross-asset visual and audio consistency while reducing per-production costs.
